Position Purpose:  The Vendor Operations Analyst identifies and presents business and operational specifications based on customer and business needs, industry best practices and available technology. Implements processes, systems and methodologies to meet the company’s business initiatives. Assists Vendor Management with vendor performance management, governance and oversight, data analytics and reporting, risk and compliance monitoring, and implementation support.   
 Applies performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) that allow the business to analyze, evaluate and report vendor performance to senior management, including performance against contractual SLAs, quality metrics, and regulatory requirements. 
 Monitors the productivity and quality of vendor services by analyzing data, reports and processes (site evaluations) to ensure contract terms, requirements and specification are met. Identifies performance degradation, trends, and operational risks requiring remediation. 
 Prepares reports on vendor performance to internal oversight committees and assists in corrective action plans. Develops vendor performance reporting and supports vendor governance meetings and business reviews. 
 Identifies systemic issues and develops and executes strategies to address these issues across vendor specific initiatives. Seeks recommendations by management to improve vendor’s performance. Tracks associated risks, issues, action items, and commitments through resolution. 
 Assists in the requirements, planning and implementation of vendor processes and reports to support new products, joint ventures and other business activities in which Enterprise Vendor Management is engaged. Participates in cross-departmental implementation teams and supports vendor onboarding, transitions, and operational readiness before go-live. 
 Ensures vendor SLA and other KPI reports are provided to management as requested and instructed, and monitors adherence to contractual and service-level commitments. 
 Validates the accuracy of data and statistics, including vendor-reported metrics and outcomes. 
 Examines reports to isolate trends and potential issues; focusing on clean up and root cause analysis, including operational, compliance, privacy, and performance risks. 
 Works with Management to monitor corrective action plans and communicates performance concerns, risks, and recommendations to leadership. 
    Education/Experience:  Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Finance/Accounting, Business or other technical/analytical field or equivalent experience. Degree with an emphasis in statistics, math or related field preferred. Some training in Six Sigma, ISO, SAS 70 and TQM preferred. Three to five years experience in an operations/processing position. Minimum three years analytical and data processing experience. Pay Range: $56,200.00 - $101,000.00 per year    At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.  You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.  Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules.  Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status.  Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.  Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.  Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act  Originally posted on  Himalayas

  Able to perform 5 days' shift work including weekends & Public Holidays (8am-5pm / 4pm-1am / 12am-9am).

Role Title:  HR & People Operations Expert 
 
 Role Type:  Contractor 
 
 Location:  Remote, global 
  Opportunity Snapshot  
 
 Pay:  Up to $90/hour equivalent 
 
 Time per task:  ~10 hours per task 
 
 Location:  Fully remote — no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred) 
 
 Next step:  Complete the role-specific AI interview — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client 
 
 Your tasks:  Design realistic, multi-step HR and people operations tasks with objective criteria for grading the output 
  Engaging experienced HR and people operations practitioners to design the tasks that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain knowledge is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.  The work is to turn real HR workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve written a policy, built a payroll checklist, or trained someone to handle employee cases against a standard, that’s the instinct this needs.  Scope of Work  
 Design multi-step tasks drawn from real HR work — payroll operations, workforce planning, policy application, employee lifecycle processes — with realistic reference files and clear instructions. 
 Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output. 
 Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly. 
 Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: policy documents, payroll reports, headcount data, employment agreements. 
 Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway. 
 Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level. 
  Preferred Qualifications  
 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in payroll, workforce planning, HR policy, or employee lifecycle operations — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure. 
 Experience creating or applying structured standards: HR policies, payroll checklists, process documentation, compliance frameworks, or training assessments. 
 Comfortable working across spreadsheets, reports, and policy documents at the same time. 
 HR certification (SHRM, CIPD, PHR or equivalent) is a plus, but not required. 
 Strong English, written and spoken — B2 minimum, C1 preferred. 
 AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required. 
  How the selection process works  
 Apply and complete the screening questions 
 Complete the AI interview for this role — even if you’ve interviewed with us before, a role-specific interview is how we showcase your domain expertise to the client, and it gives you the strongest shot at being selected 
 Profile review 
 Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up 
  A very attractive and competitive package is offered.  Originally posted on  Himalayas

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. You will leverage your deep understanding of warfighting, weapons targeting, defense operations, and international humanitarian law to support the development of frameworks that responsibly evaluate military and humanitarian scenarios. This is a unique opportunity to influence technology at the intersection of operational expertise and conflict ethics while working alongside other experts at the forefront of these domains.  Scope of Work  
 Develop comprehensive taxonomies for military-use and defense operations within diverse conflict contexts. 
 Create dual-use triage frameworks that help distinguish between military and civilian applications of technology and knowledge. 
 Establish clear boundaries for prohibited assistance under international humanitarian law, providing structured input for AI training and evaluation. 
 Design conflict-risk rubrics and scenario-based evaluation tools to assess operational and ethical implications of defense activities. 
 Evaluate and refine policy-relevant benchmarks to ensure responsible testing of AI models in defense and humanitarian contexts. 
 Contribute written and verbal analyses articulating complex warfighting, targeting, and IHL concepts for interdisciplinary audiences. 
  Preferred Qualifications  
 5+ years of relevant military, defense analysis, or IHL experience; ideally 8–20 years for senior contributors. 
 Advanced degree (e.g., MA, LLM, PhD) or equivalent operational experience in military science, security studies, international law, or related fields. 
 High credibility and established track record in warfighting, operational planning, targeting law, or humanitarian law application. 
 Expertise in interpreting and applying conflict ethics, IHL, and defense policy frameworks in real-world scenarios. 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical and ethical concepts clearly and concisely. 
 Experience in research, policy analysis, or advisory roles within military, governmental, legal, or think-tank environments. 
 Prior involvement with conflict analysis, war-crimes investigation, or weapons-policy development is a strong plus.

Job Title:  Domain Researcher, Finance (M&A)   Job Type:  Full-time  Location: Remote     The Role    Join our research team as a  Domain Researcher (DR),  where you'll help advance AI-powered financial reasoning, with a focus on Corporate Development, Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), and strategic transactions.    We're looking for professionals with hands-on experience in corporate development, acquisition evaluation, and M&A execution who can translate real-world financial expertise into rigorous AI evaluation frameworks.    What You'll Be Doing   
  Design and develop evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and scoring methodologies for AI agents operating in corporate development and M&A workflows.  
  Create realistic test cases covering acquisition screening, valuation, financial due diligence, deal structuring, and strategic investment decisions.  
  Evaluate AI-generated financial analyses, valuation models, acquisition assessments, and investment recommendations.  
  Translate real-world M&A experience into structured datasets, research scenarios, and measurable evaluation criteria.  
  Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and product teams to identify model limitations and improve financial reasoning capabilities.  
  Conduct applied research and document findings to advance AI performance in corporate finance and acquisition-related tasks.  
   What We're Looking For   
  Strong professional experience in Corporate Development, M&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Strategic Investments, with direct exposure to acquisition-related transactions.  
  Hands-on experience across the M&A lifecycle, including target screening, valuation, due diligence, transaction analysis, or deal execution.  
  Strong understanding of acquisition strategies, financial modeling, company valuation (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions), and strategic fit assessments.  
  Experience preparing or evaluating investment memoranda, acquisition recommendations, and transaction-related financial analyses.  
  Ability to translate complex financial workflows into structured research questions, evaluation frameworks, and measurable criteria.  
  Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.  
  Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  
   Preferred Qualifications   
  Direct experience within an in-house Corporate Development team, particularly involving buy-side acquisitions.  
  Experience executing or supporting M&A transactions from target identification through due diligence and closing.  
  Background in technology-sector acquisitions, SaaS businesses, or strategic investments.  
  MBA, CFA, or relevant advanced financial qualifications.  
  Familiarity with AI agents, large language models, AI evaluation methodologies, or financial AI applications.

About the role:  We're looking for a Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team.
